Arenberg Fly-over
Arenberg Course
Overview
18 holes, played in order from the first tee by the clubhouse.
5,881 m yellow
Par 72
Bruno Steensels
The fly-over stops after every stroke. Tap the yellow button, or press Space or Enter, to hit the next shot. Plan: yellow tees, driver 180 m, 3-wood/hybrid 150 m, 5–6 iron 128 m, 7–8 iron 108 m, PW 88 m, wedge 55 m. . Terrain: Wallonia aerial photo and LiDAR heights, relief exaggerated 1.5×. Routes and hazards are traced by eye, so landing spots are approximate. Imagery and elevation data © Service public de Wallonie.
